title.narrative: Enhance access to life-saving sanitation and Hygiene services in Konduga LGA, Borno state.

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtltbrgtThe Goal of this WASH and gender-based violence mainstreamed project is to reduce open defecation to 5% in Towuri and Dalori communities in Konduga LGA five months after the project ends. The project outcome is to ensure that 5,000 IDPs access to life-saving sex-segregated sanitation and hygiene services improved from 55% to 80% within the project lifespan. AHAI will promote best hygiene and behaviors practices, construct 55 hand washing stations and distribute WASH NFIs top-ups. In addition, we shall carry out fecal sludgement management including emptying, collection, transportation and disposal as well as construction of two (02) new sex-segregated on-site solar powered ventilated improved pits with exterior lightening to protect women and girls at night, provision of locks inside for safety during usage and with ram and without stairs at the entrance for inclusive access for persons with disabilities. To ensure implementation of these outputs and activities we shall establish a legal framework with BOSEPA within the first month of the project for the delegation of authority to the private sector to carry out fecal sludge management. In addition, we shall sign contracts with contractors within the first month of the project to construct new sanitation including sex-segregated ventilated improved pits, hand washing stations. To achieve the project outcome,the project will require $100,000 plus experienced and qualified program and operation staff plus a community based approach to organize series of workshops in Towuri and Dalori and distribute sanitation and hygiene kits to sustain sanitation operation and maintenance translating best hygiene promotion messages into practice while also improving knowledge of rights holders and duty bearers on gender-based violence prevention and mitigation principles through awareness raising on social norms and gender inequality stereotypes using media and art. These interventions are sustained by existing relevant policies: HNRP 2025 objective of strengthening localization agenda through capacity building of existing local government structures (BOSEPA RUWASA) WASH sector second allocation strategy as well as Borno state 25 years sustainable Development plan. Moreover, the intervention is contextually relevant to address the assessed gaps of lack of sewage systems and improve sanitation access to 5,000 IDPs in Konduga LGA, Borno state. lt/pgt
